verdict.rationale: uv explicitly ships a `uv pip` interface described as a 'drop-in replacement for common pip, pip-tools, and virtualenv commands' (uv-docs-5, uv-docs-31), and supports migrating existing requirements.txt files via `uv add -r` (uv-docs-42), letting pip/poetry/pyenv switchers keep familiar workflows. However, community hands-on reports show real gaps in parity — missing `--user` flag (uv-comm-8), non-sticky `--no-binary` behavior blocking some migrations (uv-comm-5), and users noting 'you end up needing to use uv pip so it's not even a full replacement for pip' (uv-comm-16). Missing for 10: comprehensive command-for-command parity evidence, and resolution of the specific incompatibilities users hit when trying to replicate exact incumbent-tool behavior.
